data.description:
A forbidden art that breaks the seal upon the user's soul, loosing its raw light to strike the enemy. The user is remade from within, wounds turning to new life as the strength drains from their blows.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user throws their arms wide and the seal upon their soul cracks open, a golden core blazing to life at their chest. Ribbons of pale soul-light pour out of them and spin around their body before one lashes out to strike %target. Within that whirling light %user's body unmakes and remakes itself, turning every wound into new life, though the rebirth drinks the strength from their arms until their blows fall soft as ash. What rises from the light is harder to kill than what entered it.

suggestion.title: New icon, animation and text
suggestion.rationale: The old text described green flame and the old art showed fire and water, but the jutsu deals non-elemental damage. The new icon upgrades the original players liked (the same white-haired warrior, now readable at small sizes), the new text matches what the jutsu does, a new cast animation shows the seal cracking open and the soul-light ribbons wrapping the caster, and while the absorb lasts two ribbons quietly orbit the caster to show the protection is active.
